name: focustrace
description: Local-first WCAG 2.2 accessibility rule engine and runtime focus debugger.

scripts.coverage:critical: npx --yes pnpm@11.25.0 --package=vitest@4.1.11 --package=@vitest/coverage-v8@4.1.11 dlx vitest run --config vitest.coverage.config.ts --exclude "tests/e2e/**" --coverage
scripts.quality:validate: npm run rules:validate && npm run i18n:validate && npm run deadcode:validate && npm run coverage:critical
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings entrypoints lib shared tests tools playwright.config.ts vitest.coverage.config.ts wxt.config.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run build:e2e && npm run test:e2e
scripts.release:check: npm run standards:validate && npm run axe:validate && npm run capabilities:validate && npm run quality:validate && npm run check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:edge && npm run build:firefox && npm run validate:builds && npm run bundle:validate
scripts.release:check:full: npm run release:check && npm run e2e
